faces.f: To some mages, the meaning of life is less important than how much is left.
At the first sign of enemy scouts, Jula grinned and strapped on his diplomacy helmet.
Apes can be gentle, contemplative beasts—but context is everything.
"Hard to imagine," mused Hanna, stroking the petal, "such a lovely flower inspiring such greed."
The student searches the world for meaning. The master finds worlds of meaning in the search.
Summoners of efreeti remember only the power of command, never the sting of regret.
The mind is a beautiful bounty encased in an annoying bone container.
Unlike previous conflicts, the war between Urza and Mishra made Dominaria itself a casualty of war.
"What separates us from mere beasts is the capacity for self-improvement."
Designed to restrain petty thoughts, but used to repress entire empires.
Valuing scholarship above all else, the inhabitants of the Ivory Tower reward those who sacrifice power for knowledge.

"Know your foes' strengths as well as their weaknesses."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi machinist

"It offers you what you want, not what you need."
—Braids, dementia summoner
Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

"I will go to any length to achieve my goal. Eternal life is worth any sacrifice."
—Zur the Enchanter
Her leadership forged the *Weatherlight*'s finest crew.
"Each year that passes rings you inwardly with memory and might. Wield your heart, and the world will tremble."
Each of his twenty-two braids is bound with bone and leather from a foe.
It gathers against the coming storm.
The Soul of the World has returned.
Many sigils, one purpose.
To gain audience with the hegemon, one must bring a riddle she has not heard.
"One score and four he reigned, the Southland king: / A dragon coiled, a tiger poised below the mighty Yangtze."
To save this plane, he must forsake all others.
"My eyes are my strongest feature."

There is no glory to be gained in the kingdom of the dead.
—Vec tomb inscription
Spring is the most beautiful season in the grove, when the new leaves open from their ember-buds in a race of leaping flames.
If it can't be had here, it can't be had on any world.
Both forge and pyre.

"Yawgmoth's corpse is a wound in the universe. His foul blood seeps out, infecting the land with his final curse."
—Lord Windgrace
It is everywhere you've ever been.

"Leshrac, my liege, grant me the power I am due."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer
The smallest seed of regret can bloom into redemption.
The priests plead for your anguish and pray for your despair.
"We could no more abandon the forest than the stars could abandon the night sky."
"You call it luck. I call it preparation."
Each flower identical, every leaf and petal disturbingly exact.
Urza's metathran children were conceived, birthed, and nurtured by an integrated system of machines.
"Many must die for the one who should not have perished."
Over such beauty, wars are fought. With such power, wars are won.
Izzet mages often acquire their magic reagents from dubious sources, so the potency of their spells is never predictable.
His marvels of artifice pale in comparison to the developing machinery of his mind.
There is always a greater power.
As the green sun crowned, Phyrexian prophecies glowed on the Tree of Tales.
When a werewolf changes for the first time, that first howl is said to echo through the wilds till moonset.
A bloody dawn broke over a scabbed and tortured world.

"Keep with you only this much: your mount, your blade, and your wits. The rest you can find, build, or take."
—Horse clans' wisdom
The progeny of the Maelstrom shows no allegiance—and no mercy—to any of the five shards.
Elvish dawnhands test a relic's worthiness before collecting it for the safehold. If it can't stand up to a stiff breeze, it's left behind.
Their war forgotten, the nations of Bant stood united in the face of a common threat.
The calm comes after the storm.
All must fall, and those who stand highest fall hardest.
Legend speaks of the lost coastal polis of Olantin, whose inhabitants' hubris enraged the sun god Heliod.
"Wrath is no vice when inflicted upon the deserving."
Where Razia was aloof and untouchable, Aurelia is on the frontlines, calling for war.
A golden helix streaked skyward from the Helvault. A thunderous explosion shattered the silver monolith and Avacyn emerged, free from her prison at last.
Some angels protect the meek and innocent. Others seek out and smite evil wherever it lurks.
No more shall the righteous cower before evil.
She enraptures all, encompasses all, endures all.
Wounded soldiers looked up, grateful for her appearance. But she passed over them, her eyes firmly on their foe.
Sudden vengeance, echoing fury.
She is the apex of the artificer's craft, the spirit of the divine called out of base metal.
Born with wings of light and a sword of faith, this heavenly incarnation embodies both fury and purity.

"After death you face paradise, damnation, or Tariel."
—Priest's teaching
Those who hear her go mad with inspiration.
The Patriarch is long dead, but his name still stains the lips of cultists.

"It's self-indulgent, I admit, but I do like to watch my own symphony play itself out."
—Nicol Bolas
Once Mirrodin's brightest hope. Now Phyrexia's cruel champion.
"An imperfection in the perfect world? We can't allow that."
Lands ravaged, cities in ruins, so many lives sacrificed, and yet there was no other word for it but victory.
For his family, Barrin made a funeral pyre of Tolaria.
Marit Lage lies dreaming, not dead. When will she awake from her icy prison?

"Wings that once bore hope are now stained with blood. She is our guardian no longer."
—Grete, cathar apostate

Upon discovering what had become of her sisters, Sigarda could only weep.

"Unfortunately, all my test animals have died or escaped, so I shall be the final subject. I feel no fear. This is a momentous night."
—Laboratory notes, final entry

n: Elbrus, the Binding Blade // Withengar Unbound

There are not enough lives on Innistrad to satisfy his thirst for retribution.
She now hears only Emrakul's murmurs.

Jace, Vryn's Prodigy // Jace, Telepath Unbound

faces.f:
"My mother once told me angels sing their swords' names with each strike."
—Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*

"And the flamingos said, 'Get out of our nest—we can't be seen with the likes of you!' So, the griffin ate them."
—Azeworai, "The Ugly Bird"

"That does it! I'm going back to hunting chickens!"
—Rhirhok, goblin archer

"Harah swung his sword mightily, but still the air held him fast."
—Azeworai, "Kenechi's Dream"

"The true dishonor for a soldier is surviving the war."
—Telim'Tor

The lion blinked
—Femeref expression meaning "situation avoided"

"If it bears wings, I will pin it to the skies over Tefemburu."
—Ruya, Zhalfirin archer

"You stop breathing for just a few minutes and everyone jumps to conclusions."
—Zarkuu, necrosavant
There is no wall that can't be improved by making it taller.

"By the tongues of a thousand serpents, this time I do not lie."
—Ahmahz il Kin, Suq'Ata diplomat
Asmira's prayers alone should have freed Mangara from the amber prison . . .

"These things will protect you while I'm gone, remind you of my love for you."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

"My soldiers fought without hesitation, died without doubt."
—Sidar Jabari

"Tread upon the meek, and they shall wound your feet and make you crawl."
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

"Good is not a 'thing.' You can neither touch nor own it. No, Good is a vision we all share and strive to make real."
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

"And darkness shall be cast from me
For my soul resides in the Sun."
—Femeref dirge

"They may seem ceremonial, but their swords are still sharp."
—Kipkemboi, Kukemssa pirate

"We are to be bound together as the reeds of a basket."
—Asmira, Rashida, and Jabari, unity chant

"War is the crucible of leadership."
—Rashida Scalebane

"Sometimes a burden can be borne only on the shoulders of a willing enemy."
—Suq'Ata aphorism

"He blows a gust across the cliff to vanish in a breath of wind."
—"Song of the Wind Being"
For the chronatog, there is no meal like the present.

"You know you've angered the gods when the clouds turn against you."
—Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*
First the insult, then the injury.

"Some say the sea is jealous of the land and wishes to climb its heights to meet the sky."
—Afari, *Tales*

"Controlling time ensures you need never look impulsive again."
—Teferi

"Madness and genius are separated only by degrees of success."
—Sidar Jabari
Fear the mists, for they are armed.

"Beauty to the eye does not always translate to the touch."
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

"Magic is my thread, my will the needle. I weave over you as if you never were."
—Poetics of Hanan

"Wealth is a good thing, compared to poverty—your food is better, your robes are softer, and your companions have bathed more recently."
—Kipkemboi, Kukemssa pirate

"A beauty made more so by its fleeting visitations."
—Teferi

Life or death: which is the illusion?"
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

"Kaervek believes the drakes' cries herald his victory; in truth, they mourn aloud for his impending demise."
—Teferi

"Fire is dead. Water has killed him."
—From *The Stories of Nature*

"Time may heal all wounds, but what heals time?"
—Teferi

"Oft have I wished to undo past deeds, but never did I imagine they would be undone for me."
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

"Careless, like a child with fire, so was I with time."
—Teferi

"Fly us higher, out of its storm."
—Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*

"Your arrogance amazes me, Kaervek. Did you not know the price you would pay?"
—Mangara

"Kaervek imprisoned Mangara out of jealousy, but he taints Jamuraa simply out of spite."
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

"It's like waking on a bed of a thousand olives during an earthquake of subtle force."
—Afari, *Tales*

A rhino's bargain
—Femeref expression meaning "a situation with no choices"

"Once I dreamt of death, but now it dreams of me / And only rats and rotting flesh can hear my silent plea."
—Mundungu chant

"As you breathe your last, understand why I accept such forbidden gifts."
—Purraj of Urborg

"Watch death wait / Wait, death, watch / Steal breath swiftly / but steal life slowly."
—Suq'Ata dirge

"Kill a creature, destroy the present. Kill the land, destroy the future."
—Kaervek
In troubled times, there are few greater sorrows than a wayward savior.

"I offered you eternal life; I just didn't say *where*."
—Shauku, Endbringer

"The end justifies the means. What do I care if I rule over the dead rather than over the living? The dead ask fewer questions."
—Kaervek

"Ah, I remember my first death."
—Zarkuu, necrosavant

"I have seen the horrors Kaervek has freed. My betrayal is certain—but of Kaervek or of Jamuraa, I cannot say."
—Jolrael

"Aku, City of Hidden Graves / Aku, City of Lost Kings / Aku, welcome me."
—Pillar tomb inscription

"How can you claim the gods are merciless when they robbed the snake of its limbs to give the other creatures a sporting chance?"
—Hakim, Loreweaver

"The cyclops shrugged off savage blows, but casual insults made him weep."
—Azeworai, "The Cyclops who Couldn't"

"My pet will pick the ripe fruit from your tortured brain as if it were hanging from a vine."
—Kaervek

"I write upon clean white parchment with a sharp quill and the blood of my students, divining their secrets."
—Shauku, Endbringer

"So the vulture said to the griffin, 'You gonna eat that?'"
—Azeworai, "The Ugly Bird"

"The blood on my hands is merely proof of my ambition."
—Kaervek
Some dwarves can only be pushed so far.
Embermages aren't well known for their diplomatic skills.
"Next!"

"May you get the mount you deserve."
—Suq'Ata curse

"Some say a great cyclops turns the world in its hands, looking down upon it with its one bright eye."
—Afari, *Tales*
Wanted: Thick-skinned goblin for guarding mean ol' Kookus. Must like fires. Must heal quickly.

The mightiest clouds sit upon spires of fire.
—Femeref adage

"Why is loud stupidity so infectious?"
—Rana, Suq'Ata market fool

"Ate up all of his siblings in the first week. A good beginning for one destined to command."
—Suka, ogre matron

"Every temper tantrum makes another angry gorilla."
—Femeref children's myth

"Flog and Squee / Up the tree / See the army / Flee, flee, flee."
—Goblin nursery rhyme/war cry

"Good ol' rock. Nothing beats rock."
—Rhirhok, goblin archer

"A burst of hot air tossed the moon into the air, and the moon liked it up there so much it never needed the ground again."
—Azeworai, "Glitter Moon"
Purraj sang slaughter and danced death.
It prefers its meals cooked.

"Never stop 'til you see your lance come out the other side."
—Telim'Tor
In the Talruum language, there is no word for "surprised."
When the Talruum began to play, the dragons fell from the sky to squash the obnoxious noise.

"Where do you run when the earth becomes your enemy?"
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

"Some believe Sandstalkers to be illusions; those with scars know better."
—*Zhalfirin Guide to the Desert*

Four gray trees and a long, coiling snake. What am I?
—Zhalfirin riddle

"My horizon was the arcing petals, my new home resplendent with spires of weeds and pillows of fragrant pollen."
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

"Mold could catch you."
—Suq'Ata insult

"How have I angered nature that she would imprison me in a labyrinth of grass?"
—Kasib ibn Naji, Letters

"The elves can hide better than most can look."
—Mwani, Mtenda herder

"If a rhino's head is lower than its shoulders, trust me—it is *not* praying."
—Mwani, Mtenda herder

"'I've seen hornworms big as a man's fist,' the traveler said, and nodded soberly when our jaws went slack at his ignorance."
—Afari, *Tales*
Wind will win, whatever we wish.

If you find yourself and a friend being chased by a King Cheetah, you have but one chance: Trip your friend.
—Suq'Ata wisdom

"Their tears spill over Jamuraa. Mixed with blood, they wash everything red."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"
. . . but the price of Mangara's freedom was Asmira's life.

"When you run you're graceful and swift, sleek as a powerful panther."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

"The land has been gracious enough to let you tread upon her for years. That privilege is about to end."
—Liefellen, Quirion exarch

"Respect the earth, for it will one day be your shield and another day your blanket."
—Liefellen, Quirion exarch

"But no one heard the snake's gentle hiss for peace over the elephant's trumpeting of war."
—Afari, *Tales*

"I've dreamt of a second harvest but fear I will not see it."
—Asmira, Holy Avenger
Prayers for rain are answered with the thunder of hooves.

"Our love is like the river in the summer season of long rains. / For a little while it spilled its banks, flooding the crops in the fields."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

"Is it true that the apes wear furs of gold when they marry?"
—Rana, Suq'Ata market fool

"Too much work—it takes a long time to break them in, and more than a few recruits."
—Grebog, goblin swine-rider

"As the winds abated, there was a shower of dragonscales, then nothing more."
—Azeworai, "The Unruly Wind"

"Do not underestimate the power of many against one."
—Sidar Jabari

"Far too many soldiers have died in their beds."
—Telim'Tor

"Then she spread a fine dust over the land, like a butterfly shaking its wing."
—"The Enchantress," Femeref tale

"If it can scar the sky with fire, do not share its destination."
—Mwani, Mtenda herder

"Retainer of eternal Sun! Life flash again upon thy wings."
—"Song to the Sun," Femeref song

"Our buried kings silently await the revolt of dead peasants."
—Tuwile, mundungu of Aku

"This is a war without neutrality."
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

"With Rashida's blades, my guiding vision and the luck of the blessed, today we will free Mangara!"
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

"The black-and-white sacred monkey holds her children to her, and waits."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

"He traded sand for skins, skins for gold, gold for life. In the end, he traded life for sand."
—Afari, *Tales*
With Suleiman's ascension to power, the djinn and efreets of ancient Rabiah learned humility.

"Its speed will be equaled only by the swiftness of my enemy's fall."
—Kaervek
The Viashivan understand that cruelty arises from opportunity.

"A pretty toy. Now show me its tactical applications."
—Telim'Tor

"With no further options, I was forced to don the mask."
—Rashida Scalebane

"This little prize will cover your head, your spells, your bets, and your behind!"
—Pashad ibn Asim, Suq'Ata trader

"If my heart had a lid, I would lift it and show you my joy."
—From Suq'Ata wedding ceremony
BOOM!
Some potmakers claim to use the mud of such creatures to make their finest bowls—and that the bowls scream when fired.

"I have heard terrible tales of black rains, ashen fields, and metal that screams. I have consoled myself that the tales were a myth of some fevered mind. But today I saw a walker—and now I fear the truth."
—Kasib Ibn Naji, Letters

"But once, with a magician's help, Time was stopped and Day stood still."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

"With this ring, you have friends in worlds you've never heard of."
—Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*

"Uh, does anyone have a flute?"
—Rana, Suq'Ata market fool

You'll never miss what you never had.

"Where are falling feathers deadlier than falling rock?"
—*The One Thousand Questions*

The clerics saw her as a divine gift. She saw them only as allies in her war against Phage.
War destroys more than just the land. War destroys hope.

"The hum of the universe is never off-key."
—Mystic elder
"I'm up here. You're down there. Now who's the lower life form?"
"My destiny is to save others so their destinies may be achieved."

"Nothing can stop the power of life—not even death."

The Cho-Arrim fought Mercadia's decadence with more than just swords.

"An angel appeared in the smoldering skies above the fray, her clothes as flames, her armor as fire."
—"Hymn of Angelfire"

Whoever survives the first blow lives to land the second.
Banking steeply, the aven streaked toward the ground—and vanished.
Light's champion in the stronghold of darkness.
"Such a lord as this—all virtues' height—Had never been, nor ever was again."

Some find inspiration in their swords. Others find it in their leaders.

"I am the purifier, the light that clears all shadows."

Good strategists seize opportunities. Great strategists make their own.

"Prophecy is whatever one makes of it, but destiny cannot be changed."
—Sidar Jabari
Alone at the portal, Ertai began his meditation. He realized immediately that he was not alone.

"Dauthi blood is Soltari wine."
—Soltari Tales of Life
It marks the border between here and hereafter.
His outer calm belies his inner fury.
The smallest seed of regret can bloom into redemption.
The light of reason follows them even into battle.

"There shall be a vast shout and then a vaster silence."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

"War is the crucible of leadership."
—Rashida Scalebane
Some tides need no moon.

As elusive as the footprint of a djinn
—Suq'Ata expression

"Do as I think, not as I do."
—Jace Beleren
The pyromancer summoned up her mightiest onslaught of fire and rage. Jace feigned interest.
"The specimen seems to be broken."
From nothing came teeth.
"Try to pretend like you understand what's important."
Motivation was high in the academy once students realized flunking their exams could kill them.
Don't trust your secrets to the sea.
"There's nothing like the high seas to clear your head or escape pursuers."
"I have no need of a map. The continent itself guides my way."
Hunger is like the sea: deep, endless, and unforgiving.

"These sorcerers always seem to have another surprise up their sleeves."
—Zur the Enchanter

"Beauty to the eye does not always translate to the touch."
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher
The question strained his sanity. The answer snapped it in half.

"I have a hunch we'll be seeing that one again soon."

Summoners of efreeti remember only the power of command, never the sting of regret.
"I am as the wind that bears me: harsh yet gentle, fleeting yet ever-present. Together we fly beyond imagination."

They drift in and out of shadow and ever on toward madness.
It is said that the wind will blow the world past if you wait long enough.
The calm comes after the storm.
Closing time comes earlier to some than to others.

"I'll wring out your tiny mind like a sponge."
—Urborg witch

"As with any malevolent being, the trick is knowing how long you can afford to keep it in your service."
—Liliana Vess

"Each syllable chills your veins. Each word rattles your mind."
—Cabal Patriarch
Eating is all it knows.

"The people wiped the sand from their eyes and cursed—and left the barren land to the hyenas and vipers."
—Afari, *Tales*

"Leshrac, my liege, grant me the power I am due."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

"The Dauthi believe they dignify murder by paying for it."
—Lyna, Soltari emissary
Infested with vermin, ever hungering, dropping from night's sky.
In troubled times, there are few greater sorrows than a wayward savior.

"Better to starve to death than be bored to death."
—Liliana Vess

"The young can be quite dangerous. Trust me, I should know."
—Ertai, wizard adept
The priests plead for your anguish and pray for your despair.
Chainer's dark gift to a darker soul.

"Ash is our air, darkness our flesh."
—Phyrexian Scriptures
One chill blast—the exhalation of the grave.

"You will learn to earn death."
—Volrath

"I am confined by sleep and defined by nightmare."

"This one has not screamed enough to show effective implantation. Kill it."

In Urborg, few things are less permanent than death.

"I write upon clean white parchment with a sharp quill and the blood of my students, divining their secrets."
—Shauku, Endbringer
"My eyes are my strongest feature."
He craves only one commodity.

"Every act of destruction has a repercussion."
—Karn, silver golem
Whether trained, ridden, or eaten, few goblin military innovations have rivaled the bug.
She wished for a weapon, but not for the skill to wield it.
The least popular goblins get the outer caves.
Like a sleeping dragon, Shiv stirs and groans at times.
Embermages aren't well known for their diplomatic skills.

"For dim-witted, thick-skulled genetic mutants, they have pretty good aim."
—Sisay, captain of the *Weatherlight*
Volrath leaves no stone untrained.
When you've got nothing, you might as well trade it for something else.

With a commando around, somebody's gonna get hurt.
Lead, follow, or run around like crazy.
Giant-sized body. Goblin-sized brain.
At the first sign of enemy scouts, Jula grinned and strapped on his diplomacy helmet.
There's always room for one more.

"Take the sharp metal stick and make a lotta holes."

Be it ever so crumbled, there's no place like home.

The bigger they are, the harder they avoid work.

The pulsing heat of the midday Sun burns in the Lion's eye.
—Stone inscription, source unknown
Hope of deliverance is scorched by the fire of futility.
Options will cost you, but a lack of them will cost you even more.

"Wood is wasted in the dirt."
—Orcish proverb

"I order you to volunteer."

"I like goblins. They make funny little popping sounds when they die."

—Lyna, Soltari emissary

Hunters lure the stripling boar into the open, hoping to trap greater prey.
They say the forest has eyes. They never mention its claws.
Massive, mindless, and imbued with one terrible purpose.
"Don't mistake my creations for mere vegetation. They are my children, loyal and fierce."
Nature's strength outlives the strong.
He provides a safe path to nowhere.
"We could no more abandon the forest than the stars could abandon the night sky."

"First through the Riftstone was Genesis—and the world was lifeless no more."
—Scroll of Beginnings

"I hate insects of every sort. The only mercy is that they are generally small."
—Mwani, Mtenda goatherd
Seeking the company of plants ensures that your wits will go to seed.
Broad as a baobab—and about as smart.
Nature's secrets can be read on every tree, every branch, every leaf.
Seton dreams of life renewed.
Mirri did not have time to think, only to react.

These monkeys mean business.

Gaea battles rampant death with abundant life.

"Don't laugh. It works."

—Marchesa, the Black Rose
"I am not at liberty to reveal my sources, but I can assure you, the price on your head is high."
